answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The willow cap is upheld at intake and river shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a opal tag. That is 35 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
